changelog:
• Create orders, send them to courier and update their status from your phone
• Accounting on the go: record income and expenses with receipt photos, approvals, cash, invoices and profit & loss
• Record payments using your store's own payment methods
• Instant new-order notifications
• Much lighter on battery: the SMS gateway sleeps until there is a message to send
• New signing key: if you have an older version installed, uninstall it once before installing this one
